Name: Cloud Bus Map Compatability Mod (Formally Mineral Town - Ridgeside Patch)
Author: CloudTheWolf
Description:
There's only so many warp points on the Bus Stop map and so many mods you really want to try!
Well here I come with a mod to hopefully address mod conflicts at this very busy bus stop!

This mod originally was made to fix an issue I had with Ridgeside and and Mineral Town fighting for real estate to warp the player!

Here's what's currently supported:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6427]Ayeisha - The Postal Worker (Custom NPC) [/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13996]Welcome to Mineral Town[/url]
[/list]
Additionally, fixes have been made to make this mod work with the following:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29295]Kids for the School. [/url]﻿
[/list]
If you find any other mods that clash with these mods let me know and I will try to add compatibility

Downloads.Description: Place into your Mods folder and ensure the folder name is zMineralTownRidgesidePatch so it loads after Welcome-to-Mineral-Town

Manifest.Name: MineralTown Ridgeside Patch
Manifest.Description: Moves the MineralTown warps further to the right to allow Ridgeside access
Manifest.Author: CloudTheWolf
